drums.description: Boom bap hip hop instrumental, A dusty, sampled drum break features a crisp snare and a slightly swung kick pattern, A repetitive, four-bar melodic loop consists of a jazzy electric piano chord progression layered with a muted, melodic bassline that follows the root notes, A subtle, high-pitched vinyl crackle persists throughout the track, Occasional rhythmic scratches from a turntable punctuate the end of every eight-bar phrase, The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the steady drum groove and the soulful Rhodes-style keys, 92 BPM, C minor, 4/4 time signature Publish

bass.description: Alternative rock with a heavy, distorted bass-driven sound, The track features a prominent, fuzzy bass guitar playing a syncopated, rhythmic riff that anchors the composition, A standard drum kit provides a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and driving hi-hats, Gritty, overdriven electric guitar layers enter with power chords and melodic accents, The arrangement is instrumental, focusing on the interplay between the thick bass tone and the percussive elements, 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature, key of E minor Publish
